title: Grouped summary, closures
label: Grouped summary, closures
description: The grouped summary as PHP closures over each group. SqlTable and PolarsTable collect the rows and run the closures in a DataFrame.
workload: 1,000,000 rows of events and 100,000 rows of dims

check.note: Identical result row counts across implementations and runs.

implementations.SqlTable: Phibble\Sql\SqlTable on a SQLite 3.45.1 file, through PDO

method: Fresh PHP process per run. Timing from loaded input tables to the result collected into PHP and its rows counted; lazy backends run their query within the timing. Loading (measured in Table load) and process startup excluded. One warm-up per implementation, then 7 rounds with implementations alternating in rotated order.
time_spent_in: The PHP process; SQLite and Polars run in it as linked libraries.
memory_method: Peak anonymous memory: RssAnon from /proc/PID/status, sampled every millisecond by peakmem (phit bench/peakmem.c), whole process, inputs included. Peak resident set size: getrusage() maximum, mapped file pages included. PHP allocator peak: memory_get_peak_usage(true) at the end of the run; SQLite and Polars allocations excluded. SqlTable tables remain in the SQLite file, read through a page cache of about 2 MiB (SQLite default cache_size, memory mapping off). The kernel file cache counts in neither memory measure; SqlTable memory is mostly the rows collected into PHP.

threads.PolarsTable: Polars' default thread pool, one thread per core (2 here)

reproduce: cc -O2 -o ~/.local/bin/peakmem bench/peakmem.c  # in a phit checkout
